svg.title: Give your agent something to climb.
svg.desc: An original illustrated search landscape with a luminous route between evaluated software revisions. Accepted scores progress from 54 to 68 to 82 to 91. An orange branch marks a candidate rejected for a critical regression despite a score of 77. An unverified candidate sits outside the terrain and has no score. The landscape is conceptual and every result is illustrative. The external coding agent edits and selects; Agent Eval Kit evaluates, compares, and returns evidence.
svg.text: THE EVALUATION LAYER FOR AUTONOMOUS IMPROVEMENT
Your agent makes the next move.
ILLUSTRATIVE LANDSCAPE · NOT A SCORE AXIS
A DIRECTION YOUR AGENT CAN ACT ON.
Define what better means. Feed the evidence into the next move.
ILLUSTRATIVE RESULTS · EXTERNAL AGENT OWNS EDITING AND SELECTION
